source_name: World Bank WITS (World Integrated Trade Solution), mirroring UN Comtrade — India exports of HS 070310 by partner country, calendar year 2023
notes: Replaces an earlier dataset with imprecise/blended year attribution and 3 of 6 rows entirely null (private aggregator compilations, seair.co.in/tradeimex.in). This WITS/UN Comtrade pull is the same primary-tier source used across the site's other 20+ trade-data files. Bangladesh alone is ~33% of India's total onion export value. CAUTION CARRIED FORWARD — DGFT POLICY IS VOLATILE FOR THIS PRODUCT: onion exports are 'Free' but historically subject to a Minimum Export Price and export duty; India banned onion exports outright for ~6 months in 2023-24. Export duty was reportedly removed 1 April 2025; MEP status should be reconfirmed at time of order. Any onion content must state pricing/duty terms are confirmed at time of order, not quoted as fixed.
